evidence.result: 16 sRGB colours round-tripped via OKLCH within 3.5e-14; 4 out-of-gamut OKLCH colours mapped into sRGB (max lightness shift 0.0137); 8 Sharma pairs ΔE2000 within 4.1e-5 of published. Node 22.19.0.

summary: JavaScript colour conversion and manipulation library
use_when: Use for wide-gamut conversion, interpolation, gamut mapping and DeltaE.
avoid_when: Avoid when you need a complete accessibility contrast audit; use a dedicated checker.

assessment.rationale: JavaScript colour library supports conversion, interpolation, gamut mapping and DeltaE across modern colour spaces. MIT; npm library. Check contrast algorithm coverage separately.
